timeline.title: ACP Verma and Poonam — the awkward training test
timeline.history: Shreya previously arranged a special training assignment with gym trainer Vivek for female police-station staff; Poonam is among the trainees. Other female staff are in the program but are not silently placed in this room. Verma is leading the station-side testing. Reader-only direction: ACP Verma and Poonam have a private, not-yet-disclosed involvement.
timeline.distinctEvent: Shreya arrives during Poonam's close-contact training test. Poonam is lying on a mat while ACP Verma is positioned above her; they separate immediately when Shreya enters. The posture and sudden separation strike Shreya as awkward. Verma and Poonam explain that the test is part of the Vivek-linked women's training program. Verma says Shreya will be tested too; she teasingly asks whether he himself will take her test, and he replies yes. No additional physical act is established.
timeline.reaction: Shreya briefly finds the situation odd but has no verified knowledge of their private involvement. She and Poonam leave together. Verma's subsequent private thoughts are known to the reader only.
timeline.exit: Shreya and Poonam depart; Verma's reader-only fantasy is the scene-ending beat. Next remains the station Chotu tea-counter scene.

timeline.title: The Training Ground Challenge — five-person flag drill
characters: Kavita (23, constable in Shreya training group)
timeline.history: Vivek Rao's special training assignment for female staff already established in Beat 2. Rohas and Lokesh are existing male trainees (not twins); Meera is the third official trainee; Kavita participates as Shreya's trainee without changing her constable rank. The five active participants here are Shreya, Meera, Kavita, Rohas and Lokesh, not Poonam.
timeline.distinctEvent: In Vivek-inspired timed pursuit/flag-control drill, Rohas calls Shreya into the competition. Meera and Kavita run the first challenge against Rohas and Lokesh; Meera's speed distracts Rohas and Kavita unexpectedly wins the flag. Shreya accepts the next challenge. She initially outmaneuvers Rohas, while quiet Lokesh predicts her pivot and takes the side training tag. During the rapid tag capture, there is one brief natural close-contact moment: Lokesh's hand near Shreya's clothed waist, Shreya steadying on his forearm, then both release. Shreya notices a different momentary awareness without declaring a relationship. Lokesh's clean win surprises her.
timeline.reaction: Rohas briefly loses focus after admiring Shreya's athletic movement; Shreya catches his glance and teases him. Meera needles Rohas; Kavita enjoys her win. Lokesh wins with quiet skill; Shreya offers a competitive next-round challenge, no forced emotional monologue.
timeline.exit: Conclude at 16:05; wrap files and drive home, then society twins.
